#include <iostream>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll modpow(ll x, ll y, ll mod) {
    ll res = 1;
    x %= mod;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) res = (res * x) % mod;
        y >>= 1;
        x = (x * x) % mod;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    ll k = n * m;
    ll len = r - l + 1;
    const ll mod = 998244353;

    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        cout << modpow(len, k, mod) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    ll ans = (modpow(len, k, mod) + modpow(len % 2, k, mod)) % mod;
    ans = ans * modpow(2, mod - 2, mod) % mod;
    cout << ans << '\n';

    return 0;
}
